title: Introduce CredentialComposite and pausable Pullstream facade across SDKs
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: address recurring ergonomics gaps across SDKs when composing credential strategies (prefetch, lease windows, fallback) and when consumers need to pause/resume generator/pullstream flows for backpressure or maintenance. Implement a lightweight CredentialComposite (composition of multiple CredentialProviders with deterministic fallthrough and prefetch hints) and a pausable Pullstream facade that exposes pause(), resume(), and checkpoint() primitives on generator/async-iterator surfaces across Python/TypeScript/Go.

What this PR does (single contiguous description): Adds a CredentialComposite abstraction to SDK credential stacks that accepts ordered providers (e.g. cached-lease, delegated-refresh, fallback-proxy) and exposes a small lifecycle: prime(), lease(window_ms), refresh_if_stale(), and release(). The composite emits optional prefetch hints that the client runtime uses to warm sessions. In parallel, introduces a PausablePullstream wrapper for the generator/pullstream surfaces: python async generator wrapper (sdk-python), TS async-iterator with AbortSignal-aware pause(), and a Go Iterator facade with Pause/Resume channels. These facades are intentionally thin: they do not change wire protocol, only the client-side consumption patterns.

Cross-SDK parity: Implementations provided in sdk-python (top-level package), sdk-typescript (client generator adapter), and sdk-go (iterator + small concurrency helper). Each SDK gets tests and an example snippet in docs/examples/cred-composite-pullstream. Version bumps: python -> 1.29.0, typescript -> 1.28.0, go -> 1.8.1.

Telemetry and retries: credential events (prefetch, lease-granted, fallback-used) are emitted to existing telemetry pipeline. Retry presets updated with a new "lease-aware" retry profile that reduces jitter when a lease refresh is in flight.

Backward compatibility: No public API surface was removed; this is additive. Consumers that opt into the composite or pausable facade will get new behaviors.

Testing and CI: unit tests added for each SDK, integration test in e2e/cred-pause that simulates slow consumer/backpressure and validates resume semantics and credential prefetch. CI initially failed on a flaky TS linter rule; fixed by normalizing eslint config and re-running.

Checklist: - [x] Implement CredentialComposite (py/ts/go) - [x] Add PausablePullstream facade (py/ts/go) - [x] Add unit tests and e2e test harness - [x] Update docs and examples - [x] Bump SDK versions and changelogs - [x] Add telemetry events - [x] Run CI and fix lint/test failures

Related: ENG-3521 (credential lifecycle harmonization), ENG-3599 (stream ergonomics audit), SUP-1187 (customer reported pause/resume bug).
